scope: Published Python teaching code and example notebooks in the listed official Unidata repositories; default-branch snapshots, not full library implementation or repository history.
coverage_gaps: YouTube channel could not be enumerated; repository coverage is not proof of coverage of every video.
Code visible only in video frames or captions has not been transcribed.
External repositories, gists, and blog-only snippets are not exhaustively collected.
Hidden/generated files, website assets, and support assets larger than 10 MB are excluded; see per-repository counts.
Upstream examples are preserved, not modernized or executed. Some require older dependencies, remote data, credentials, or local datasets.
